thread.title: Why – and When – You Should Buy Apple Stock

author: By: Money Morning
title: Why – and When – You Should Buy Apple Stock
text: Now would seem to be a lousy time to buy Apple stock. It's down 21% from its peak. Anxious about negative iPhone sales reports, Wall Street analysts are stumbling over each other to downgrade the stock and chop their price targets. But those analysts are missing something crucial about the company - something that will drive the AAPL stock price to $300 by 2020. You see, this is a company in transition...
